messages.subject: Shiny File Upload Bug?
parts:
Starting around 9/17 some .csv file uploads in either the shiny upload file example, or apps that incorporate it uploaded to shinyapps.io have been generating the following error. When the apps are run locally there is no error.

Anyone have any idea what is happening?

<h1>Error</h1>
<pre>/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:65: attempt to index local 'curr' (a boolean value)</pre>
<h2>Traceback</h2>
<pre> stack traceback: /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:65: in function 'add_params' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:394: in function 'handler' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:416: in function </usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412> [C]: in function 'xpcall' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412: in function 'dispatch' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/nginx.lua:181: in function </usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/nginx.lua:179></pre>

Interesting. I tried it locally with shiny::runExample('09_upload'),
and this data file can be uploaded successfully. It just does not work
when it is deployed to ShinyApps.io. I also tried to deploy the csv
with the app, read.csv('sample.csv') in the app, and everything also
works. So it is not a problem with reading the data, but uploading it.
I have no idea about what is going on there, and hopefully other
people in the team can figure it out.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Shiny File Upload Bug?
parts:
Thanks for reporting the problem. It is in fact a bug that happens only on shinyapps.io, caused by an issue in a third party software. We have opened a ticket with them:

https://github.com/leafo/lapis/issues/159

We will let you know when problem is fixed. But as a workaround, I was able to narrow down what causes the problem in your sample file, and how to fix it. In line 12 of your file, this text:

Law & Safety 

Removing & from that text fixes the problem.

Sorry about the inconvenience.

Fereshteh

I have no idea about what is going on there, and hopefully other

Regards,
Yihui
